Trader Joe's EBTB

"The Savory Savior" — From Sub-Par to Super

Role

Art Director

Copywriter

Helana Wiese

Deliverables

Print · TV · AR · Experiential · Merch

The Foundation

Insight & Big Idea

Millennials want meals that taste homemade and impressive — but they don't always have the time, ingredients, or culinary confidence to get there. They need a shortcut that feels earned, not lazy.

The Insight

Every cook needs a sidekick

Millennial home cooks are ambitious but time-poor. They know what a great meal should taste like, but the gap between what they imagine and what they can actually pull off is real. They don't need a chef — they need a hero in their corner.

The Big Idea

The Savory Savior

We turned Trader Joe's Everything But The Bagel seasoning into a fully realized superhero character — The Savory Savior — who swoops in to rescue bland meals with a "Flavor Blast." The campaign frames EBTB not as a seasoning, but as the secret weapon every kitchen deserves.

The Character

Meet The Savory Savior

Origin Story

A fearless force of savory power — with a SHAKAPOW, he blasts your plate's bland curse straight into oblivion.

The Savory Savior is the EBTB jar brought to life: masked, caped, and armed with a Flavor Blaster that fires seasoning at anything remotely bland. He appears wherever food needs rescuing — in print, on city walls, in AR, and at live activations.

His tagline: "From Sub-Par to Super." His mission: no bland meal gets left behind.

Print Ads

Three Executions

Each print ad drops The Savory Savior into a different context — comic book origin, battle scene, city takeover — all unified by bold comic-panel art direction and the campaign tagline.

Experiential & AR

"Savory Savior in the City"

A larger-than-life Savory Savior takes over the city — bringing the campaign to life through a giant character installation, AR filter experiences, and interactive sampling activations at rooftop venues.

The AR filter — accessible via QR code at activation points — drops The Savory Savior into any environment, firing a Flavor Blast at the camera. Shareable, on-brand, and built to spread organically across social. Each scan unlocks a "Flavor Blast" moment designed to be posted.

Merch

The EBTB Tote

A limited-edition mini Trader Joe's tote bag — available in-store — featuring the custom Savory Savior illustration pattern. The bag turns the campaign into something fans actually want to carry, extending the life of the character beyond the ad.
